Here is an AUDUSD long which I took: There is a very important lesson learnt in this trade.

Scenario: I took this trade, both in demo as well as in my live account. With a well sought and thought out analysis, chose my targets and stoploss. When I got into the trade I knew I was going to take it to the take profit, no shortcuts but I also knew there was 'DBD supply sitting right in between at 76, which can stop my trade. So, the greed took the best of me and I closed my trade, for a decent 50 pips, but the point of story is "I sold my trade cheaply to the bastards"

Here is something we all must understand, when we are planning our trades, we must know where our stop losses should be and where our most logical take profits should be. There must be a reason for every why and why not, if you dont have a reason, there should be no trade.

I really believe here at RTM, we have the education good enuf for all of us to be able to trade profitably with people like IF, Doctor and many others around on this website, who are more than willing to help us become good at it but at the end of the day, what we need is, to believe in ourselves. If we cannot believe in our own analysis, however much these guys help us out, we wont be able to improve.

If somebody cares about the trade, here it is: closed +80 pips, but just in demo.

Have a nice weekend everybody!
